reconstruction.scope: Tower of Justice (Adalet Kulesi) only, fifth authored member of18 required Topkapi Palace structures. Square pale masonry shaft with real recessed barred windows, corbelled projecting balcony and muted glazed railing, taller four-sided belvedere with arched recessed glazing and eight paired corner shafts, segmental curved pediments, closed curved roof shoulders, steep square lead pyramid and small gold finial. Council Hall/attached portico, Harem and Outer Treasury remain independent. No invented clock, furnished stair/interior, exact sculptural carving, copied inscriptions, visitors or transient CCTV/maintenance equipment.

reconstruction.heightBasis: No qualified height is supplied by this standard-map parent. Picture-led working shaft16m, projecting balcony16.0-16.55m, glazed belvedere17.35-25.4m, pediment crowns about28m, square lead spire25.9-36.5m and finial37.9m. Upper window clear width3.1m; paired slender shafts rise17-24.7m. These heights, exact lower-window inventory, pane grids, corbel/capital profiles and roof seams are approximate visualization proportions, not surveyed dimensions, structural/current-condition or accessibility certification. Roof silhouette and the distinctive upper window/column/pediment arrangement guide recognition. No clock is introduced.
